snippet.title: Echoes of the Unread - Official Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Steam Announcement Trailer for Echoes of the Unread, a retro 2D Metroidvania platformer developed by Clever Cat Games. Players will traverse book-themed worlds across a musically-centric adventure. Set off as Rhapsody to find her way home in Echoes of the Unread, coming soon to PC (Steam).
